name: Memory Munitions
from: Idea 1 (80s neon shooter, a machine working against you), refined: each kill destroys a memory. Working title.
hook: You uploaded your mind into a war machine. Now every robot you shoot takes a piece of the past with it.
pitch: A Contra-style arcade shooter with a minigun and a reason to take your finger off the trigger. Every robot you destroy takes information with it. You see what you erased as it breaks apart on screen: a family photo, a map, a message you almost had time to read. You can clear the room in seconds. Getting through with the evidence intact takes a different kind of skill.
minute_check: Yes: the first robot that shatters into a photo explains it.
build_check: Yes, with one level and one robot type that carries fragments.
scope: One level. Decide the second skill (disable instead of destroy?) and give it one button.

brief.player: A mind uploaded into a combat robot.
brief.goal: Get through the level, and recover as many memory fragments as you can.
brief.ending: An album of what you kept and what you shot: the story you can piece together depends on it.
brief.theme: Speed costs memory: the fastest route destroys the evidence of who you were.
brief.look: Neon 1980s side-scroller; fragments in warm photo colours against the neon.

prov.bug: Minigun! Clear the room in three seconds!
prov.nit: What was in the robot you just shot? Can the player ever get it back?

refs_lit: The run-and-gun template: fast, readable, side-on.
Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind (Michel Gondry, 2004)
Memories erased one by one, and someone trying to keep one.
A shooter that makes the player look at what their shooting did.
omni_gameplay_prompt: 1980s arcade neon side-scrolling run-and-gun game on deep void black (#07060c) with electric mint (#5dff9e) vector grid floors and hot magenta (#ff4fb0) robot enemies. Steady side-on 2.5D tracking camera. A sleek cybernetic soldier fires rapid neon bursts, then switches to a precision disable beam: the first robot shatters into warm golden-sepia photographic memory shards floating in slow motion, while the second robot powers down intact releasing a glowing intact memory photograph. Continuous unbroken gameplay shot, no scene cuts, no HUD text. Use the reference image for perspective grid and neon palette. Sound design: punchy 80s synth bassline, laser zaps, crystalline chime. No dialogue.
